cards.name: Basic Attack
cards.text: One stack attacks an adjacent enemy stack. Stepping into an enemy zone first is a hasty assault: -2 strength.

cards.name: Hold
cards.text: One stack digs in: +1 defense until your next turn.

cards.name: Offensive
cards.text: {points} offensive points: +1 strength each, 2 to assault without the hasty penalty, or 2 for an extra attack (the first attack is free).

cards.name: Fortify
cards.text: {points} points: each adds a trench chip (+1 defense, max {limit} per hex) to a stack's hex. Spread them or pile them up.

cards.name: Defensive Posture
cards.text: All your stacks get +{amount} defense until your next turn.

cards.name: Elastic Defence
cards.text: Until your next turn, your stacks retreat for free (trade ground for men).

cards.name: Counter-attack
cards.text: Attack an enemy stack that just advanced (spent), stepping into its zone freely. {points} points: +1 strength each.

cards.name: Logistics
cards.text: {points} points: rail +1 hex of movement (1), rally +1 gear up to {limit} (2), merge adjacent stacks (1), split a stack (1).

cards.name: Home Front
cards.text: {points} points: propaganda +1 resolve (1), relief -2 war weariness (1), recruit +1 man in a home stack (2).
